allowlist.scope: Only braces 3.0.3 with patches/braces+3.0.3.patch; every installed copy must pass the bounded-recursion behaviour tests before this exception is evaluated
allowlist.reason: No official fixed release exists. The shipped patch bounds both parsing and all public recursive AST walkers, including caller-supplied/cyclic trees. run-audit.mjs makes adversarial and Metro compatibility tests mandatory and verifies the exact installed version for every lockfile copy. The API has no direct braces consumer. Replace this patch and remove the exception when an official fixed release is available. Re-evaluated 2026-10-14: npm still lists 3.0.3 as the latest braces release and the GitHub advisory (updated 2026-10-02) has no first patched version (range <= 3.0.3). The installed copy reverse-applies the patch cleanly, the 4 braces mitigation tests pass, and an unpatched 3.0.3 copy overflows the stack on the same 4,000-deep input that the patched copy rejects with a bounded RangeError. Renewed for 14 days only; re-check upstream before expiry.

The installed rsa.js reverse-applies the patch cleanly and the 8 node-forge mitigation and Expo signing tests pass (12/12 mitigation tests in total). Renewed for 14 days only; re-check upstream before expiry.
